description: A coalition of EU member states, Nordic partners, and select Eastern European allies forms a regional AI oversight and incident coordination body, independent of NATO and US-led structures, to share threat intelligence and audit high-capability systems deployed across critical infrastructure. This emerges in direct response to the repeated loss-of-control incidents and growing distrust in externally controlled AI systems, and gains momentum as Germany and France push for binding cross-border protocols. The initiative bypasses stalled EU-level ratification by operating through bilateral agreements and mutual assistance pacts.
